We are seeking a passionate and detail oriented Business Analyst to join our team in Australia. You will play a key role in bridging the gap between business needs and technical solutions by gathering requirements, analysing processes, and documenting user stories for development with ServiceNow.

Blu Pantera Tech Pty Ltd
Fortitude Valley, Brisbane QLD 4006
Full time
$140,000 – $180,000 per year + superannuation

About position
The SAP Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) Consultant is responsible for analysing business requirements, and designing, configuring and implementing SAP EAM solutions that optimise asset management and maintenance processes for clients operating in asset-intensive industries. The role partners with business stakeholders to maximise asset reliability, reduce maintenance costs and support digital transformation through effective SAP EAM solutions, while ensuring project delivery meets quality standards, timelines and client requirements.

Responsibilities
- Consult with clients, users and stakeholders to understand organisational objectives, operational requirements and asset management needs.
- Identify, investigate and analyse business processes, procedures and work practices to determine inefficiencies and opportunities for improvement.
- Define, document and validate functional requirements for SAP solutions supporting asset management and maintenance operations, and recommend process improvements and system enhancements.
- Design, configure and implement SAP Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) solutions aligned with operational requirements and industry best practice, including asset structures, functional locations, equipment records, maintenance notifications, work orders, preventive and corrective maintenance processes, maintenance plans and maintenance strategies.
- Develop functional specifications, data and process models, system documentation and process maps to support SAP solution design, configuration and development.
- Collaborate with technical consultants, developers and project teams to deliver integrated SAP solutions that meet business requirements and technical standards.
- Apply project management methodologies, principles and techniques to develop project plans, estimate costs, allocate resources and manage SAP EAM implementation activities to achieve project milestones and deadlines.
- Develop and execute test plans, including unit, integration and user acceptance testing (UAT), and coordinate data migration, master data validation, system deployment and go-live activities.
- Prepare user documentation, business process documentation and training materials, and deliver formal training to end users.
- Provide post-implementation support, troubleshoot functional issues and monitor SAP EAM processes and performance to identify improvements.
- Act as a central functional reference point throughout project delivery, liaising with clients, users, project managers, developers and cross-functional teams to ensure solutions meet requirements, quality standards and project objectives.

Skills and Qualifications required to perform the above job role
- Tertiary qualification in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Information Systems or a related discipline. 
- SAP certification or relevant SAP EAM/PM training is highly regarded.
- Minimum of 5 years' experience implementing and supporting SAP Enterprise Asset Management (SAP EAM/PM) solutions.
- Strong business analysis skills, with the ability to identify business requirements, analyse processes and develop functional specifications, process models, documentation and test plans.
- Experience in project management, with strong analytical, problem-solving and organisational skills, and the ability to oversee the implementation of complex IT projects.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage with technical teams, business stakeholders and end users.

On a full-time basis, you will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, maintaining, and improving software applications and systems. You will work closely with internal teams, business stakeholders, and technical staff to deliver reliable, scalable, and user-focused software solutions.


Job Title: Software Engineer, Full-Time Position
ANZSCO Code: 261313 Software Engineer
Employment Type: Full-time
Working Hours: 38 hours per week
Work Location: In person
Industry: Software Development / IT Services / Digital Solutions


Key Responsibilities
The successful candidate will contribute to the full software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, system design, frontend and backend development, database integration, testing, deployment, documentation, and ongoing system maintenance.

Main Duties and Tasks
- Analyse business and technical requirements and translate them into software solutions.
- Design, develop, test, and maintain software applications, platforms, and system features.
- Develop frontend interfaces using technologies such as JavaScript, React, Vue.js, HTML5, and CSS3.
- Build and maintain backend services, APIs, and application logic using suitable programming languages and frameworks.

- Conduct debugging, troubleshooting, code reviews, and performance optimisation.

- Support cloud-based deployment, version control, CI/CD, and DevOps activities using tools such as AWS, Azure, Git, Jenkins, or similar.
- Work with product managers, designers, business users, and technical teams to deliver software that meets business objectives.
- Prepare user guides, technical documentation, release notes, and system support materials.
- Maintain data security, system reliability, and compliance with workplace policies and procedures.
- Support ongoing system upgrades, enhancements, and legacy system improvements.

Essential Requirements
- Minimum 2 years of relevant work experience as a Software Engineer, Software Developer, Full-Stack Developer, or in a similar software development role.
- Experience in frontend development using JavaScript, React, Vue.js, HTML5, CSS3, or similar technologies.
- Experience with backend development, APIs, databases, and system integration.
- Knowledge of programming languages such as JavaScript, Python, Java, or similar.
- Experience with SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or other relational database systems.
- Understanding of software development lifecycle, system design, testing, debugging, and deployment processes.
- Experience using Git, cloud platforms, CI/CD tools, or DevOps practices is highly regarded.
- Strong problem-solving, analytical, and technical troubleshooting skills.
- Ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality software solutions.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced technical environment.


If you would like to discuss the role further, please click APPLY and send through an up-to-date CV. We can schedule a time to discuss the position and assess your suitability for the role.

result.description:
Job description:

Spyder Industries Australia PTY LTD is hiring a Full-time System Analyst role in Collie, Western Australia. Apply now to become part of our team.

Requirements for this role

Flexible hours available
Minimum 3 years of relevant work experience required for this role
Relevant work rights for Australia
Work location: In person
Spyder Industries Australia PTY LTD is looking for an experienced System Analyst to support the company’s ICT systems and business operations at our Collie, Western Australia location.

On a full-time basis, you will work as part of a multidisciplinary and well-supported team, consulting with business users and technical stakeholders to evaluate existing ICT systems, identify operational requirements, and recommend practical system improvements.

Position Title: System Analyst
ANZSCO Occupation: Systems Analyst – ANZSCO 261112
Employment Type: Full-time
Salary: AU$90,000.00 to AU$98,000.00 per year plus superannuation
Work Location: In person

About the Role

The System Analyst will evaluate the processes, procedures, and methods used in the company’s existing ICT systems and recommend modifications, additional system components, integrations, or new systems to meet operational and user requirements.

The successful applicant will work closely with management, business users, developers, vendors, and ICT support personnel to gather requirements, prepare system specifications, coordinate system testing, and support the implementation of reliable and effective technology solutions.

Requirements

Applicants should demonstrate the following:

Minimum 3 years of relevant experience as a System Analyst, Systems Analyst, ICT Business Analyst, or in a closely related ICT systems role
Relevant qualification in Information Systems, Business Information Systems, Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or an equivalent field
Strong understanding of ICT systems, business processes, system workflows, and operational requirements
Experience consulting with users to gather, analyse, formulate, and document business and system requirements
Experience evaluating existing systems, business processes, procedures, and work practices
Ability to identify system limitations, operational inefficiencies, integration issues, and areas for improvement
Experience preparing functional specifications, system requirement documents, workflow diagrams, process models, data models, and technical documentation
Experience supporting system implementation, integration, configuration, testing, and deployment activities
Understanding of system testing, user acceptance testing, defect tracking, quality assurance, and change management processes
Experience with Microsoft 365, Active Directory, ServiceNow, Google Workspace, enterprise resource planning systems, customer relationship management systems, or similar business platforms
Ability to prepare user guides, training materials, system procedures, technical reports, and operational documentation
Strong stakeholder communication skills and the ability to work with both technical and non-technical users
Good analytical, problem-solving, organisational, and project coordination skills
Strong attention to detail and commitment to system quality, data integrity, and continuous improvement
Ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a multidisciplinary team
Responsibilities

The System Analyst’s responsibilities will include:

Consult with users, managers, clients, and technical stakeholders to understand operational needs and formulate clear business and system requirements.
Analyse existing ICT systems, business processes, procedures, workflows, and work practices to identify limitations, inefficiencies, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
Evaluate the processes and methods used in existing ICT systems and recommend modifications, additional system components, integrations, or new systems.
Translate user and business requirements into clear functional specifications and system documentation for developers, vendors, and ICT support teams.
Use data modelling, process modelling, workflow mapping, and other analysis techniques to prepare clear system specifications.
Develop business requirement documents, functional requirement specifications, system process diagrams, data flow diagrams, process notes, and implementation documentation.
Review proposed system solutions to ensure they meet business requirements, operational objectives, technical standards, and user expectations.
Work closely with developers, ICT support teams, external vendors, and business users throughout system design, configuration, implementation, and support activities.
Assist with the preparation, adoption, and implementation of system test plans to ensure acceptable system quality, functionality, reliability, and data integrity.
Coordinate and support system testing, integration testing, user acceptance testing, issue identification, defect tracking, and resolution.
Monitor system implementation activities and confirm that approved requirements and functional specifications have been correctly delivered.
Assess system functionality and user feedback and recommend improvements to system usability, performance, workflows, and business processes.
Review and improve user access procedures, account management processes, permission controls, shared data structures, and business application workflows.
Support the deployment of functional ICT solutions and assist users during system transitions, upgrades, and process changes.
Prepare user guides, system procedures, operating instructions, training materials, and technical support documentation.
Deliver system training and provide practical guidance to staff and other business users.
Act as a central source of information and provide advice and assistance during system-related planning and decision-making.
Maintain accurate system records, configuration information, issue registers, testing records, and operational reports.
Monitor system performance, service requests, recurring user issues, and operational incidents to support reliable day-to-day business operations.
Assist with system-related onboarding and offboarding processes, including user account access, permissions, application access, and system usage guidance.
Maintain clear communication with stakeholders and provide practical technology solutions that improve operational efficiency, system functionality, and user experience.
Perform other related system analysis and ICT project duties as reasonably required.
Application

If you would like to discuss the role further, please click APPLY and submit an up-to-date CV.

Shortlisted applicants will be contacted to arrange a suitable time to discuss the position, their experience, and their suitability for the role.

Work Location: In person
